content_sections.heading: NIT Manipur Project Assistant Vacancy Details 2026
Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.Tech/M.Sc or equivalent PG degree in Water Resources/Geology/Remote Sensing & GIS with Water Resources sub-specialization with relevant B.Tech/B.E/B.Sc degree with 1st Class PG degree (desirable) or Graduate degree in B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc in Civil Engg/Agricultural Engg/Geoinformatics or eqv./Earth Science with 1st Class degree & relevant working experience in a research project of similar nature.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 35 years Age relaxation will apply as per Government of India rules.

content_sections.heading: Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Rs 25,500/- (consolidated for 1 full month/30 days) or Rs 850/- per day

content_sections.heading: NIT Manipur Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Manipur Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant position at NIT Manipur is scheduled for 31st July 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates need to have an M.Tech/M.Sc or equivalent PG degree in relevant fields like Water Resources, Geology, or Remote Sensing & GIS, or a B.E/B.Tech/B.Sc in Civil Engineering, Agricultural Engineering, Geoinformatics, or Earth Science with a 1st Class degree and relevant experience.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant post is 35 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per Government of India rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 25,500 per month or Rs. 850 per day.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant position at NIT Manipur?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Assistant position will be based on an interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the NIT Manipur office in Imphal, Manipur.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if any), and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent or contractual job?
faq.answer: This is a contractual job opportunity for the Project Assistant position at NIT Manipur.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification PDF can be downloaded from the 'Important Links' section of this article. It is recommended to read it thoroughly.
